title.narrative: UNICEF continued supporting the realization of disability rights for children, contributing to the operationalization of the National Disability System Reform in line with international standards. UNICEF-supported amendments to the regulation on the provision of Personal Assistant Services and to the Regulation of Day Care Centers were approved.  An action plan for the reorganization of special general education institutions into resource centers to support inclusive education was approved. Over 300 refugee children with disabilities received needs-based and specialized support, developmental and rehabilitation services, MHPSS and assistive technologies.
